verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents an API for retrieving a connected account's balance and for managing connected-account payouts and payout schedules, which platforms can surface in their own product. Its only documented embeddable component is account onboarding, not balances or payouts. Missing for 10: embeddable components for balances, payouts and transaction history, any transaction-history API or surface, explicit white-label/branding controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, seller-facing surfaces are embeddable — white-label components or APIs for balances, payouts, and transaction history that live inside my product under my brand

citations.quote: To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
Pay out to connected accounts: Manage payouts and external accounts for your connected accounts.
Schedule the frequency of automatic payouts
You embed the Account onboarding component directly in your application and your connected accounts go through the onboarding flow without leaving your application.
